summary.text: On Ravnica, after the Guildpact is destroyed, the Implicit Maze manifests across the plane, and Niv-Mizzet announces that each guild will send one champion to race through it, beginning at the Transguild Promenade.

The Orzhov angel's message insists that Teysa Karlov complete the maze at all costs, and Lavinia is chosen to run it for the Azorius and arrests Jace, who finally links the runners' minds, triggering the Supreme Verdict and becoming the first Living Guildpact.
Along the way, small stories play out in the city, such as Andra, who works for House Dimir, selling a dark dagger to Bartek and then arranging for it to be stolen.
